title: eludite.output.show input
description: Show the Output window (View > Output, Ctrl+Alt+O) with a source selected in its "Show output from" dropdown, and read the end of that source's text: Build is the build log, Host is eludite-host's own log, Language Servers is the log of the language servers the shell runs itself (rust-analyzer: its stderr, window/logMessage and window/showMessage), Debug is the program's output while it runs under the debugger or without it (the debug adapter's output events, or the program's stdout and stderr for Ctrl+F5) with the debugger's own messages, and Browser is the browser of the eludite.browser.* tools: its launch, tabs opened and closed, navigation failures, console errors and its exit, and Tests is the test runners' output: the Test Explorer's discoveries and runs (eludite-host's MTP and VSTest logs, cargo test's output), and Package Manager is what NuGet did: the Manage NuGet Packages window's and eludite.nuget.*'s installs, updates, uninstalls, consolidations and restores (brief 0048), and Updates is the self-updater's log: checks of the release channel, downloads, what is staged for the restart, failures and the update applied at this start (brief 0055), and Agents is the Agents window's log (brief 0059): each agent start with its command line, the agent ready with its version, the ACP version and the MCP endpoint, its login state, each prompt (its first 80 characters), each turn's end with its stop reason and duration, errors, the agent's exit, and every line the agent writes to stderr.

tail.description: How many of the last lines to return (default 50, at most 2000; 0 for none).
